snippet.title: Teardown Multiplayer - Out Now
snippet.description:
TEAR DOWN TOGETHER!

Teardown Multiplayer is Out Now — turning Teardown into a fully destructible playground for up to 12 players. Team up to tackle the campaign in co-op, jump into competitive modes like Deathmatch and Capture the Flag or unleash pure creative chaos in Sandbox Mode across every map.

But this is more than an update. It’s total freedom!

With hundreds of multiplayer-ready community mods already live and more being added constantly, the possibilities are nearly limitless. New game modes, custom maps, wild rule sets, experimental tools; if you can imagine it, you can build it. Or destroy it.

And this is only the start. More multiplayer content is already in development.

Ready to build your own Multiplayer mods or update your current ones for Multiplayer? Jump in and start creating: https://teardowngame.com/modding-mp/index.html


Community-created Multiplayer mods featured in this trailer:
- Arson Bridge & Tripmine by ancientevil581
- Firework by Jakyb
- Hamsterball by Litttle_fish
- Honey I Shrunk The Room by Spealer
- Piano Fall by Jiffy UP
- Prop Hunt by DimasVoxel & Luke Splyne. (Technical Support – Thomasims)
- Snowball Clash & Light Katana by GalaxyPizza
- T'aka Atoll by Kooshing
- VEHICLE SUMO by Edgymanx7 & Pufv
- Welding Tool by Tortoise Work


Grab Teardown on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167630/Teardown/
